fusions.name: Spore Pod Spiral
fusions.desc: After a 0.5 second cast, looses 3 spore pods in a spread, each dealing 25 damage that ignores resistances and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolled Puffball
fusions.desc: Rolls a puffball at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Fairy Ring
fusions.desc: Raises a ring of mushrooms where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Rot Returns to Root
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
